title: BigBangSwap — sellRewardToken Missing Access Control Analysis
root_cause: `sellRewardToken(uint256 amount)` has no access control, allowing anyone to sell BGG for BUSD; the reward pool was drained via repeated calls from multiple attack contract instances
steps: → [4] BGG reward pool drained through repeated execution
other_code:
Attacker
  │
  ├─→ [1] DODO Flash Loan: borrow 50 BUSD
  │
  ├─→ [2] Deploy 70 attack contracts
  │
  ├─→ [3] Each instance:
  │         ├─ Swap BUSD → BGG (PancakeRouter)
  │         └─ Call sellRewardToken(amount) → BUSD returned
  │
  ├─→ [4] BGG reward pool drained through repeated execution
  │
  ├─→ [5] Repay DODO flash loan
  │
  └─→ [6] ~5,000 BUSD profit
